benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: YES Bank’s premium credit card – Marquee is tailored to the needs of high-income individuals. Much like other premium cards, YES Marquee also offers benefits across multiple categories, with more focus on rewards and travel. With a generous sign-up bonus, unlimited lounge access, and a competitive value back of up to 4.5%, the card stands as a worthy competitor to premium all-rounder credit cards like HDFC Diners Club Black, Standard Chartered Ultimate and ICICI Emeralde Private Credit Card. Read on to know about its features and benefits, followed by a review.

faqs.q: What options do I have for redeeming YES Marquee Credit Card reward points?
faqs.a: You can redeem the accumulated reward points through YES Rewardz Portal for travel booking, miles conversion (with select airlines), vouchers and merchandise.

faqs.q: Are there any spend-based eligibility conditions for availing lounge access on YES Marquee Credit Card?
faqs.a: Yes. To be eligible for the complimentary lounge access benefit, cardholders must spend Rs. 1 Lakh in the preceding quarter. Fee payments, reversals/cancelled transactions, rental and wallet transactions will not qualify for the spend threshold.

faqs.q: I already have YES First Preferred Credit Card. Can I upgrade it to Marquee?
faqs.a: You can get an upgrade on your existing credit card depending on your eligibility and other internal policies of YES Bank. You can contact your relationship manager or speak to a customer care representative to get more clarity on this.

faqs.question: Is the Yes Bank Marquee Credit Card lifetime free?
faqs.answer: No. The joining fee is ₹9,999 + GST and the annual fee is ₹4,999 + GST. The annual fee is waived when you spend ₹10 lakh in a year.

faqs.question: What is the forex markup on the Yes Bank Marquee Credit Card?
faqs.answer: It's 1% plus GST on spends in a foreign currency. That's lower than the usual 3.5%, which helps when you spend abroad.

faqs.question: Does the Yes Bank Marquee Credit Card give airport lounge access?
faqs.answer: Yes. You get 6 domestic visits a quarter once you spend ₹1,00,000 in the previous quarter, plus unlimited international visits.

faqs.question: How much can I earn with the Yes Bank Marquee Credit Card?
faqs.answer: You earn about 1.25% back in reward points on regular spends, and up to 4.5% on its bonus categories. Check the review above for the exact categories and monthly caps.

program_updates_2026: To qualify for domestic lounge access, you must spend at least ₹1 lakh in the previous calendar quarter. From 1 April 2025, YES BANK follows the standard calendar quarter to determine eligibility.
